risks: Catalog reorder or localized rename rejects old saves.
Catalog value changes do not migrate saved role_card values.
Most gameplay reads saved role_card while AI/Codex/intel maxima can read the current catalog.
A modified save can alter executable passive fields without violating role index/name validation.
Monster-upgrade replay identity uses role index and localized label.
Catalog hash is not the frozen canonical JSON profile and is not in the save handshake.
migration_policy: Keep a bounded legacy reader mapping baseline catalog hash plus exact legacy index/name to stable role_id.
Write stable role_id per player and one session-level role_catalog_id, ruleset_id, and source fingerprint.
Do not save RoleSemanticSpec, its cache, or PassiveTriggerExecutionPlan.
Preserve materialized cash and exact-once ledgers; never recompute or replay old rewards on load.
Keep private usage in CardHistoryPrivateAnnotationService and bind it to resolved role/passive identity.
Fail closed when the referenced source version cannot be resolved and no explicit migration exists.

acceptance_gates: No Main dependency growth and final counter conversion removes Main dependency.
Role compilation and all current passive planning consume zero RNG.
Random setup role selection preserves RunRng draw count, checkpoint, terminal cursor, and rollback behavior.
No new semantic save section; semantic caches/plans are absent from saves.
Legacy index/name saves either migrate explicitly or fail closed with backup guidance.
New saves contain stable role IDs and a source catalog handshake, not full role definitions.
AI receives only public neutral role semantics and retains its own weights.
Public DTOs expose no exact cash, hand card, responder identity, private annotation, hidden unit owner, or AI plan.
Each retained passive has active rule authority, one static owner, one typed trigger/capability path, and one existing domain mutation owner.
Exact-once ledgers and private usage survive round trip without replaying rewards.
No duplicate passive execution path remains.
highest_risks: Saved full role definitions can determine gameplay while AI/UI read current catalog values.
All 12 passive families lack active v0.6 role authority.
Ten per-minute city/facility texts execute per sale receipt.
Three starting-cash bonuses are applied but absent from setup passive text.
Counter conversion rewrites live hand data in Main and carries private source_card_name.
Bonus-card grant is a second post-purchase transaction whose failure is ignored.
Localized name and array index couple setup, save, AI, Codex, art, and receipts.
City reveal and city guess reward lack role execution owners; public exclusion cannot establish a legal exclusion.
